answer.value: Decoder-only transformer using GQA and NoPE (with 3:1 ratio); 3B parameters. No layer count, experts, or design rationale stated.
quotes: The model is a decoder-only transformer using GQA and NoPE (with 3:1 ratio), it was pretrained on 11.2T tokens with a staged curriculum of web, code, math and reasoning data.
SmolLM3 is a 3B parameter language model designed to push the boundaries of small models.
